notes.title: New trailer is OUT! Playtest starting in 1 week.
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="HroNM8VdSug;full"][/previewyoutube][p]New trailer is out on our Steam page, and the official release on Youtube will be on Friday.[/p][p]In only 7 days we are launching our Kickstarter campaign to help make this game a reality.[/p][p]You will also be able to play the current development build of the game next week![/p]

notes.title: Try IMMORTAL on September 16th! / Kickstarter announcement
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315319/89d7d54290e28e1aa970b87bf356708f54e2ab32.png"][/img]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’re back with a pretty big announcement.[/p][p align="start"]Originally we wanted to launch our Kickstarter at the beginning of the year, but thanks to some cool people who noticed our preview page we had an opportunity to prepare a bit more and take a breath before launch. [/p][p align="start"]This allowed us to work more on the game first of all. It was great to be able to work in a team again and we made a lot of progress on planned features and content. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315319/f73f1d0e620e6df2c9ee20a8cd9e312698f6ec4b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We believe that now is the best time for us to do the crowdfunding campaign we envisioned and share our work and story with all of you.[/p][p align="start"]We will have a playable build available during the campaign for anyone who is willing to try. Details on how to download the game will be shared during our Kickstarter campaign. We will make sure that you don’t have to be a backer to play the game though, so everyone can give it a go.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315319/a17601cf49bd9e9b3f60be52002f3e0f88b59bd3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is not a conventional demo, but rather a unique build where you’ll be able to visit an in-development game, take an interactive guided tour through all the game’s many mechanics and try what it feels like to play a “real level” as well. We’ll place “under construction” signs where needed, and we’ll give a look into both the polished parts of the game and lots of unfinished mechanics we are working on. Knowing our team, it is very likely that the build will be updated during the campaign too! [/p][p align="start"]You will also get access to all of our developer menus and will be able to do things not normally available in demos. Hopefully this too will give an interesting look into how the game works.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315319/b22eef7b4f757bd2f6cc454049eaa9d096aa06eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]This playtest will be available for 30 days while our Kickstarter campaign is going. [/p][p align="start"]How to get notified? Well you can do the boring route of putting it into your calendar, but if you subscribe to our Kickstarter pre-launch page - you’ll get notified when the build goes live as well as get cool updates, more in-development stuff, patch notes, etc. etc etc. And again - [b]you don’t have to be a backer to play the game - it’s for everyone! [/b][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/weareimmortal/immortal-and-the-death-that-follows" style="button" buttoncolor="#05ce78"]Kickstarter page[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Go here to sign up for updates and see you on September 16th in the Titan Realm![/p][p align="start"]Oh, and check out how we updated the page overall![/p]

notes.title: IMMORTAL going on KICKSTARTER!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315319/0e7690e367335354bc970bd508b1aa5f15cf7ad3.png[/img]

Hey everyone! 
Hope you're all having the best holidays, taking the time for family and your backlog of games!
After lots of pondering and careful consideration and research we have decided that taking a chance at a crowdfunding campaign to finish the game with our community could be the best way forward.

To that end we have launched a sign-up page for our KICKSTARTER campaign coming in Q1 2025!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/weareimmortal/immortal-and-the-death-that-follows]IMMORTAL - Coming soon on KICKSTARTER[/url]

We will be launching the campaign as soon as the demo is done and we have enough sign-ups. Experts say that it has to at least be 1k followers on a Kickstarter page to ensure success.

The demo in question will feature a full vertical slice of the game that you can play as a mini-roguelike for a bunch of hours. There's even a true and a normal ending to unlock, NPCs to meet, gang members to recruit and so on. As usual you can catch more detailed progress reports on our X and Bluesky pages.

We have also updated our Steam page description, so please check it out to get the latest and probably clearest picture so far on the game's planned features and gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315319/d6365fe012e890b8fe5d5a6b09223fb0cb774b09.png[/img]

The campaign itself will have a lot of cool news and updates on the team and the game too.

If you are interested in participating in the campaign we kindly ask to follow our page on KICKSTARTER! 

Happy holidays!!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315319/1cb62f3735369feaa8360d92428d035d4f3941c5.png[/img]
